external_boundaries.finding: Legacy online currency reader scrapes Google Finance and disables TLS verification. It is not used by the new HR delivery. Local explicit currency values need no network. A future online adapter needs a separately verified finite provider contract.
Legacy IP geolocation fetches ipinfo over HTTP. It is not used by the new HR delivery. Manual attendance/shift/leave flows do not depend on this service.
Legacy mailbox/mail-support transports are outside the native internal article/inbox delivery. Local records/training do not require credentials.
